explication: Cell Architecture Studio is a browser-based educational cell gallery. Learners choose a specimen, inspect its 3D model and organelles, and can branch into comparison and study tools; saved preferences and learning progress persist locally. The graph emphasizes the documented product capabilities and the sampled App orchestration, data, rendering, and progression code. Several component internals were not sampled, so their specific call relationships are left out.
